offering_description.value: Owns and operates senior living communities, providing housing, personal care, meals and health-related services to older adults. Residents and families pay monthly fees, delivered by its own staff in communities it owns or leases.

primary_services.value: independent living; assisted living; memory care; continuing care retirement communities; home health and hospice

customer_segment.value: B2C: senior residents and their families, mostly private pay

end_markets.value: senior living; elder care; healthcare services

revenue_model.value: service fees: monthly resident fees for housing, meals, care and community services; healthcare reimbursement: Medicare and Medicaid payments for home health and hospice services

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns or leases senior living communities and runs them, serving older adult residents; service provider: delivers personal care and health services to residents

geography_served.value: US national: communities in about 40 US states

specialization.value: related lines: independent living, assisted living, memory care, continuing care and ancillary health services

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated senior living communities; online: website lead generation and inquiries; other: referrals from hospitals, physicians and senior placement advisors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state licensing of assisted living and memory care, Medicare and Medicaid rules for home health and hospice
